name: Assault Mastery
summary: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Adaptive Defence
summary: Adeptus Astartes models in a terrain feature re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. Units also gain Entrenched while in terrain, not set up that turn, and having moved 3" or less this turn.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability gain: Furor Tactics — if the devastator doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; Malleus Tactics — if the tactical doctrine is active, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS]; Purgatus Tactics — if the assault doctrine is active, its attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of it have [PRECISION]. DEATHWATCH units may be included without the army's Chapter keyword, up to 500 points total. Unless otherwise stated, a DEATHWATCH model cannot be the WARLORD. KILL TEAM units take enhancements only from this detachment.

name: Devastator Mastery
summary: Once per battle, you can select the devastator doctrine one additional time.

name: Purge and Sanctify
summary: Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead. Restrictions: your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Combined Deployment
summary: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Walking Fortress
summary: In a turn in which a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Defence
summary: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Enduring Vengeance
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, excluding walker units, can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll for their ranged attacks.

name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
summary: Sword Brethren Squad units get +1 Objective Control. Army can include Black Templars units only, no other Chapter's Adeptus Astartes units.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: When a friendly Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot, choose one of the following: those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden; or that unit can make a normal move of up to D6", and that unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Speeder units have +2" Move.

name: Tactical Mastery
summary: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
summary: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
summary: Friendly Tacticus units' attacks with the [Rapid Fire] ability benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units at any range up to that attack's maximum range.

name: Death Blow
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

name: Templar Vows
summary: At the start of the first battle round, select one of three Vows, active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle. Vow 1: this unit's melee attacks targeting a PSYKER unit have [PRECISION] and [LANCE]. Vow 2: friendly melee attacks targeting a unit with T greater than this unit's S have +1 to wound rolls. Vow 3: friendly INFANTRY units secure objectives they control at the end of your Movement phase, and an advance move does not prevent eligibility to start an action. Army may include Black Templars units but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.
